title: A cancelled run's end still reads as done/0 from watch — latent, nothing writes that state today
body: The reconciler never currently writes runstate.StateCancelled (it is vocabulary only), but the resume path's already-terminal branch writes run_finished "the run is already cancelled: …", and the new failed classifier deliberately classifies only the failed word — so a cancelled end exits 0 / state "done". If a future tick starts cancelling runs (a stop that must be distinguishable from completion, as 2jn's A4 asks for failed), the watch and the exit-table vocabulary need a decided answer for it; the overview already names it its own word.
demonstrating_check: go test ./internal/cli/ -run TestWatchExitsFailedWhenTheRunEndedFailed (a sibling test on a 'the run is already cancelled:' terminal line demonstrates the 0 today)
